title: A stable power-sum Macdonald operator gives simple joint spectrum with stable Cherednik operators over Q(q,t)
author: Bechtloff Weising, Milo J.

difficulty_reason: The author constructs a genuinely new convergent scaled finite-rank power-sum operator, separates its symmetric tail using a stable idempotent identity, and computes its limiting eigenvalues. Together with the Cherednik operators it resolves every previously degenerate weight space. The convergence construction and spectrum form one unit, not a separately counted easy eigenvalue consequence.
